name: copilot-plus-plus
description: AI-powered Git workflow automation for VS Code. Generate smart commit messages, comprehensive PR descriptions, conduct automated code reviews, and detect breaking changes using advanced language models.

copilotPlusPlus.languageModel.markdownDescription: Preferred language model family for Copilot++. Use the command `Copilot++: Select Language Model` to pick from supported models. [Select model](command:copilot-plus-plus.selectLanguageModel) · [Reset to default](command:copilot-plus-plus.resetLanguageModel)

copilotPlusPlus.defaultTargetBranch.description: The default target branch to select for PR description and review. If not set or if the branch doesn't exist, will try to use 'main' or 'master'.

enumDescriptions: Gitmoji style with emojis (e.g. ✨ Add new feature)
copilotPlusPlus.commitStyle.description: The style of commit messages to generate

copilotPlusPlus.includeTicketNumber.description: Include ticket numbers from branch names in commit messages

copilotPlusPlus.ticketPattern.description: Regex pattern to extract ticket numbers from branch names

copilotPlusPlus.prDescriptionStyle.description: Style of the PR description generated

copilotPlusPlus.includeTechnicalDetails.description: Include a summary of file changes in the PR description

copilotPlusPlus.groupCommitsByType.description: Group commits by type in the PR description

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.includeSecurity.description: Include security vulnerability checks in PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.includeCodeStyl.description: Check code style and best practices during PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.includePerforma.description: Analyze code for potential performance issues during PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.includeBreaking.description: Check for breaking changes in PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.enableInlineLin.description: Enable clickable links to navigate to files with issues

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.severityLevels.description: Severity levels for categorizing issues in PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.includeLogicalE.description: Check for logical errors, edge cases, and flawed business logic implementation during PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.includeTestingG.description: Identify missing or inadequate test coverage during PR reviews

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.maxTokensPerGro.description: Maximum tokens per file group when processing large PRs. Higher values process more files together but require more capable models. Recommended values: 6000-8000 for GPT-4o-mini, 16000-32000 for GPT-4o/Claude, up to 64000 for latest models.

copilotPlusPlus.prReview.enableDebugLogg.description: When enabled, saves debug logs for LLM requests and responses when errors occur. Useful for troubleshooting JSON parsing issues.

copilotPlusPlus.ignoredFilePatterns.description: Glob patterns for files to ignore in git diffs. Defaults to a comprehensive set of non-development files including minified code, compiled output, binary files, and third-party dependencies.

copilotPlusPlus.breakingChanges.includeP.description: Include private APIs in breaking changes analysis

copilotPlusPlus.breakingChanges.includeI.description: Include internal implementation details in breaking changes analysis

enumDescriptions: Strict - Detect all potential breaking changes, including minor signature changes
Moderate - Detect significant breaking changes that would affect most consumers
Lenient - Only detect major breaking changes that would affect all consumers
copilotPlusPlus.breakingChanges.detectio.description: Detection sensitivity level for breaking changes analysis

scripts.compile: pnpm run build:webviews && pnpm run build:extension
scripts.build:extension: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run build:webviews:prod && pnpm run check-types && pnpm run check-types:webviews && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
scripts.check-types:all: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run check-types:webviews
scripts.lint:all: pnpm run lint && pnpm run lint:webviews
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:webviews && pnpm run test
